regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing, non-directional thematic tape: 22 of 49 themes are trend-eligible, the absolute-trend gate is the only validated edge here (gate_helps=true) and it is doing its risk job, but cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is weak and rotation timing has no forward edge. Leadership sits with AI Infrastructure (rank 1, uncrowded) but breadth is thin (0.125), while the Energy Complex and Cybersecurity round out the top three with stronger breadth; no single narrative dominates.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the Energy Complex completes a CONFIRMED handoff from AI Infrastructure as tape leadership — the observable to retire this watch would be XLE closing two consecutive weeks ahead of SMH on a 20-day relative-return basis while AI Infrastructure's breadth stays below 0.25 and Energy's breadth holds above 0.6.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is the highest-conviction eligible overweight in the tape: it is trend-eligible with the best breadth among leaders (0.636), durability above the 0.5 bar, and is not crowded (crowding_z 0.93, below flag threshold). Unlike the AI Infrastructure leader, which leads on raw score but has thin breadth (0.125), Energy shows participation across constituents, which is the kind of cohesion the durability lens rewards for a staying-power, drawdown-controlled lean. Detector legs supporting: rank/eligible, durability_bar, and breadth are all constructive; crowding is a non-issue.
evidence: US Energy Complex rank 2, score 1.375, eligible=true
theses.dissent: Energy is highly cyclical and sensitive to a growth scare or crude-price reversal; the rank is a coincident focus lens with ~0 forward IC, so this is a trend-continuation judgement only, and the Energy theme can unwind fast if macro risk-off hits commodities.

falsifier.text: XLE's 20-day return falls below the S&P 500's by 3% while the theme's breadth drops below 0.5 before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the strongest trend-health name in the top tier: it carries a 'trend' hurst_tag (the only top-3 name to do so), the highest breadth-quality durability_bar of the leaders (0.75), and good breadth (0.6). The catch is crowding: crowded=true with crowding_z 1.61, which per guardrails is a SIZE-DOWN caution only, not a fade. A modest overweight lean is defensible on trend persistence, but conviction stays low because crowding caps the position and the detector offers no return forecast.
theses.dissent: The crowded flag is exactly the regime where leaders reverse on attention spikes (do_not_conclude: thematic inflows mark tops); with rank-IC ~0 there is no edge in chasing a crowded #3, and a sentiment unwind could hit CIBR hard.

falsifier.text: CIBR's 15-day return lags SPY while its crowding_z stays above 1.5 and breadth falls below 0.5 before the check-by date.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure is the headline leader and is trend-eligible and uncrowded (crowded=false), so a continuation lean is the least-wrong default under the trend-gate discipline. However the breadth is the thinnest in the top tier (0.125) and the headline r10 is negative (-0.0916), suggesting leadership is concentrated and may be stalling. Per guardrails I do not treat the #1 rank as a buy signal and do not fade it; conviction is low because the rank is a focus lens, not alpha.
evidence: AI Infrastructure rank 1, score 1.56, eligible=true, crowded=false
theses.dissent: Thin breadth (0.125) plus a negative 10-day return and mixed trend regime means the leader could be rolling over; leadership concentrated in few names is fragile, and the detector's own rank has no predictive power.

falsifier.text: SMH's 15-day return lags SPY by 4% while AI Infrastructure's breadth stays at or below 0.15 before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
